transcript.text: Everything you want is on the other side
of a few hard conversations that you
have been putting off. People either
grow into their potential or they keep
living the same 6 months of their life
over and over again. And the difference
is how many hard conversations you're
willing to have and how fast you have
them once you realize you need to.
